title: Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU案例中比較Fresnel光學register與二體距離圖，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate fresnel optical register and pair-distance graph within the Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU case.

steps.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Optical-tweezer arrays and loading: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對Fresnel光學register提出可反駁的光鑷陣列與裝載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable optical-tweezer arrays and loading model and evidence record for fresnel optical register.
steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Fresnel光學register。中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 建立光鑷陣列與裝載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify fresnel optical register in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU. Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of optical-tweezer arrays and loading, focusing on device constraints, atom layouts and pulse validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。
steps.observationEn: Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.
steps.check: 提交Fresnel光學register的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fresnel optical register.

knowledge.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載
knowledge.text: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 本課架構對應：Fresnel光學register
knowledge.textEn: Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Course architecture correspondence: Fresnel optical register

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設兩原子交互作用能移服從 U=C6/r⁶，距離增為 1.05 倍且 C6 固定，U 比率=1.05⁻⁶=0.746215。這是兩體尺度比較，未含驅動、多體及讀出，非裝置控制設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume U=C6/r^6 for a pair. Increasing separation by 1.05 at fixed C6 changes U by 1.05^-6=0.746215. This omits drive, many-body effects and readout and is not a device setting.

quiz.question: 就Fresnel光學register的「光鑷陣列與裝載」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for optical-tweezer arrays and loading in fresnel optical register?
options: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。
名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry.
Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。
quiz.explanationEn: Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.

steps.title: 光鑷陣列與裝載：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical-tweezer arrays and loading: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對Fresnel光學register提出可反駁的光鑷陣列與裝載模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable optical-tweezer arrays and loading model and evidence record for fresnel optical register.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「光鑷陣列與裝載」模型，檢查Fresnel光學register的兩個假想案例。由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分中性原子由光學勢能井定位；裝載缺位與重排決定可用幾何。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous optical-tweezer arrays and loading model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving fresnel optical register. Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Optical potentials position neutral atoms; loading vacancies and rearrangement determine usable geometry." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 由假想佔位圖統計完整陣列率與重排次數。
steps.observationEn: Compute full-array fraction and moves from a hypothetical occupancy map.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：名義陷阱數等於每次實驗的可用原子數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Nominal traps equal available atoms on every run.
steps.check: 提交Fresnel光學register的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for fresnel optical register.

steps.title: Rydberg 阻塞與距離：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Rydberg blockade and distance: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對二體距離圖提出可反駁的Rydberg 阻塞與距離模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable rydberg blockade and distance model and evidence record for pair-distance graph.
steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識二體距離圖。Rydberg 相互作用對原子距離敏感；常見模型以 C6/r6 描述兩體位移。 建立Rydberg 阻塞與距離的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在固定 C6 的假想模型比較 1.0 與 1.1 倍距離。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pair-distance graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU. Rydberg interactions depend strongly on distance; common models use C6/r6 for pair shifts. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of rydberg blockade and distance, focusing on device constraints, atom layouts and pulse validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在固定 C6 的假想模型比較 1.0 與 1.1 倍距離。
steps.observationEn: Compare 1.0 and 1.1 separation at fixed assumed C6.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：原子距離改變隻影響圖像，不影響哈密頓量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Atom spacing changes only the picture, not the Hamiltonian.
steps.check: 提交二體距離圖的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for pair-distance graph.

stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate time-dependent hamiltonian and pulser sequence constraints within the Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU case.

steps.title: 類比哈密頓量：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對時間相依哈密頓量提出可反駁的類比哈密頓量模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable analog hamiltonians model and evidence record for time-dependent hamiltonian.
steps.instruction: 在「Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識時間相依哈密頓量。驅動、失諧與幾何共同定義時間相依模型；類比演化不等於任意數位閘電路。 建立類比哈密頓量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用小系統矩陣重算本徵值與控制參數變化。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify time-dependent hamiltonian in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU. Drive, detuning and geometry define a time-dependent model; analog evolution is not an arbitrary digital circuit. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of analog hamiltonians, focusing on device constraints, atom layouts and pulse validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用小系統矩陣重算本徵值與控制參數變化。
steps.observationEn: Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：類比退火可自動代表所有數位量子演算法。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Analog annealing automatically represents every digital algorithm.
steps.check: 提交時間相依哈密頓量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 關聯函數與有限樣本：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Correlators and finite samples: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對有限樣本關聯函數提出可反駁的關聯函數與有限樣本模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable correlators and finite samples model and evidence record for finite-shot correlators.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「關聯函數與有限樣本」模型，檢查有限樣本關聯函數的兩個假想案例。比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous correlators and finite samples model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving finite-shot correlators. Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。
steps.observationEn: Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：單一樣本足以證明多體相。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One shot establishes a many-body phase.
steps.check: 提交有限樣本關聯函數的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for finite-shot correlators.

knowledge.title: 關聯函數與有限樣本
knowledge.text: 關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。 本課架構對應：有限樣本關聯函數
knowledge.textEn: Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter. Course architecture correspondence: Finite-shot correlators

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；單一樣本足以證明多體相。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: One shot establishes a many-body phase.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設兩原子交互作用能移服從 U=C6/r⁶，距離增為 1.05 倍且 C6 固定，U 比率=1.05⁻⁶=0.746215。這是兩體尺度比較，未含驅動、多體及讀出，非裝置控制設定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume U=C6/r^6 for a pair. Increasing separation by 1.05 at fixed C6 changes U by 1.05^-6=0.746215. This omits drive, many-body effects and readout and is not a device setting.

quiz.question: 就有限樣本關聯函數的「關聯函數與有限樣本」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for correlators and finite samples in finite-shot correlators?
options: 單一樣本足以證明多體相。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。
optionsEn: One shot establishes a many-body phase.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples.
quiz.explanation: 關聯量依多次樣本估計；空間結構與有限樣本偏差需同時檢查。 比較獨立樣本與相關樣本的均值及誤差條。
quiz.explanationEn: Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter. Compare means/error bars for independent and correlated samples.

summary: 以公開裝置約束、原子佈局及脈衝驗證解析Pasqal Fresnel 光鑷 QPU：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Pasqal Fresnel optical-tweezer QPU through device constraints, atom layouts and pulse validation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假設兩原子交互作用能移服從 U=C6/r⁶，距離增為 1.05 倍且 C6 固定，U 比率=1.05⁻⁶=0.746215。這是兩體尺度比較，未含驅動、多體及讀出，非裝置控制設定。
workedExample.textEn: Assume U=C6/r^6 for a pair. Increasing separation by 1.05 at fixed C6 changes U by 1.05^-6=0.746215. This omits drive, many-body effects and readout and is not a device setting.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變模型邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are independently selected assumptions, not measured hardware, ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after boundary changes.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開架構及領域原理，不宣稱來源提供這組假想數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public architecture and principles, not these assumed measurements.
